verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes a documented public REST API. It covers OAuth 2.0 authentication with per-endpoint scopes, a broad accounting surface (invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports, bills), search and paging parameters, error docs, HMAC-verified webhooks, a Postman collection and an official Node.js SDK on GitHub. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents drive the API successfully, and AI-friendly doc formats (llms.txt and markdown docs both return 404).
